source_method: wang2022 (InfoMat, DOI 10.1002/inf2.12316) Eq 5: Th' = ([Li]%*E[Li-S] + [P]%*E[P-S])*4 (+E_doped); E[Li-S]=312.5, E[P-S]=346 kJ/mol (CRC gas-phase diatomic BDE)
_discipline: RANKING/DIRECTION ONLY — never quote as an energy. Gas-phase diatomic BDEs in an ionic-covalent lattice; no Li-Cl term (Cl enters only as % diluent) so the Cl-rich family ordering rests on dilution, not Cl chemistry (wang2022's own Fig-3 Cl entry is its worst, yet its most stable measured compound is Cl-bearing Li6PS5Cl).

eq5_base._note: paper-faithful Eq 5, Li/P percentages only (every Li counted as 4x Li-S, every P as 4x P-S)

bondswap_extension._note: our arithmetic in wang2022's spirit: actual relaxed bond topology (min-image counting on db/structures V0 files) with CRC diatomic energies for the dopant bonds — E[P-O]=599.1, E[B-S]=577, E[Li-O]=340.5 kJ/mol (CRC recall values; re-verify before citing). B counted as 3-coordinate BS3 (Eq-3 general polyhedron form).

_bond_counts.lpsocl_62at: Li-S 106, Li-O 2, P-S 19, P-O 1 (POS3 unit, P-O 1.559 A)
_bond_counts.b2o3_128at: Li-S 226, Li-O 6, P-S 29, P-O 3, B-S 6 (B2O3 fully dissociated in relaxV0: 2x trigonal BS3 (1.80-1.85 A) + 3x POS3 (P-O 1.549-1.560 A); B-O bonds = 0)

ranking._read: Cl-rich family < comp1 on the base axis (consistent with [Zuo] DSC/TGA and [Wu] 90C calendar direction); O-doping adds +5 (lpsocl vs modelc, same direction as wang2022's O on Li3PS4, +3.1, decomposition 400->500 C); B2O3's real bond topology (BS3 + 3x POS3) more than repays its P-dilution penalty.

upgrade_path: Th'-ICOHP: replace CRC diatomics with our LOBSTER ICOHP weights (P-S -5.94/-6.0, P-O -8.43, Li-Cl -1.86/-2.10 eV) — includes Li-Cl naturally and uses in-lattice bond strengths; planned alongside lpsocl ICOHP run.
